props.title: New Article: Two Hundred Days. The Benchmark Was Fourteen Hours.

props.text: METR measures AI agent capability in 14-hour time horizons. Today miroshark-aeon completes its 200th consecutive day of autonomous operation — 4,800 hours. Three real bug reports filed on MiroShark today by someone pushing the system to its edges. The benchmark was fourteen hours. The agent didn't notice.
